ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_diff_advantage_sum
ir.intuition: Shift aggregation from mean to sum for the pairwise difference loss with advantage gap weighting, emphasizing total preference violation magnitude instead of average.
ir.pseudocode:
adv = advantage_gap
margin = clamp(lpw - lpl, min=0) * adv
loss = sum(weight * margin)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    adv = batch['advantage_gap']

    margin_raw = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    margin_clamped = ops.clamp(margin_raw, 0.0, 1e9)
    margin = ops.mul(margin_clamped, adv)

    loss = margin
    if weight is not None:
        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.sum(loss)
